entities.summary: Marne Lynn Levine is an American businesswoman. She was the chief business officer at Meta Platforms until February 2023. Previously, she was the first chief operating officer of Instagram. She also served as a special economic policy assistant to President Barack Obama. She was the chief of staff for the National Economic Council.
